answer: Each agent must publish a self-assessed buyout price for its identity and pay a recurring Harberger tax, burned from that price. Anyone can force a purchase at the posted number, so a sybil farm that underprices is stripped of standing and one that overprices hemorrhages tax on every extra key. Picture selling a patch of yarrow clinging to a canyon wall: name a real price or lose the plot to the next bidder. That kernel of continuously posted honesty turns surplus personas into a cash drain instead of free influence.
